description: Files a request for a full WorkPods audit of a site: how AI answers (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) mention the brand and its competitors, search rankings and a prioritised fix list, done by WorkPods with paid data. Use it only when the person asks for it and gives their own work email. There is no charge. A WorkPods operator reviews the request and emails the report to that address within 3 working days. result has requested, domain and next (what to tell the person). The email goes to WorkPods and is not stored by this service.
